features: Four new rankable powers, three charged champion ultimates, four milestone-gated Power Relics, four additional achievements, Nightmare and Eternal contracts, and late-wave corruption pressure.
Three rankable run powers: Chain Tempest lightning, Riftstrike dash shockwaves, Soul Dominion attraction and healing; three permanent milestone-gated Power Relics start runs at rank 1.
Auto removes mobile 30 FPS cap, adapts pixel density, caches static low-quality arena, stops hidden menu rendering, retains Eco mode and improves power relic styling.
Mobile control hotfix: disjoint grid regions for joystick and right-hand combat buttons, touch/pointer/click fallback with cooldown deduplication, versioned entry module.

Dash works from rest and locks a direction for the full burst; analog movement, multi-touch combat buttons, cooldown rings, safe-area aware portrait/landscape HUD, scrollable menus and reduced mobile rendering workload.

Unique true Canvas2D weapon silhouettes for each actual playable champion: Void Warden wields twin curved crescent sickles, Frost Sentinel a crystalline glaive with shield, and Ember Reaver a broad cleaver with offhand fire dagger.

Earn champion mastery by casting signature abilities three times during the same run. Third cast awakens a stronger combat form: Warden SUPERNOVA gains radius, knockback and damage; Sentinel ETERNAL WINTER gains barrier duration, freeze reach and 12 HP restoration; Reaver DRAGONFIRE gains a stronger wider slash and extended burning. Mastered casts have shorter cooldowns.

Mastery progress appears in the existing Q/touch POWER HUD and in-run Warden Codex; a character aura and mastery effect render within the current Canvas2D engine, with Eco mode protecting mobile responsiveness.

Additional forgeable cosmetic weapon appearances ASTRAL FORGED (two completed expeditions + two Eclipse Shards) and DOMINION FANG (boss defeat + two claimed achievements + three shards); always free CHAMPION SIGNATURE weapons. Real weapon shapes and projectile colors reflect selection; no stat bonuses.

Legacy cosmetics extend the existing independent localStorage key with ownedWeapons/equippedWeapon, preserving existing armor sets, shards and achievement claims and safely defaulting older saves to signature weapon.
The Armory's three champion choices display live model previews rendered by the exact game engine; the Legacy wardrobe and Codex previews show the actual forged armor and weapon combination.

Retains the complete v1.6 Armory, relics, achievements, cosmetics, rare shards, 3 champion abilities, weapon evolutions, v1.5 realm quests, phased bosses, saved records, independent offline PWA and PROXIMUS media.
privacy: Scores only in this game's localStorage; no access to Asset Alchemist video files.
